On 2026-10-22 the maintainer widened it into a renovation program (D-WORKFLOW-181, on `feature/m6-renovation-plan-346` until merged): modernize, standards and best practices, bugs, package currency, efficiency (computation, memory, the player's time), dead ends, clarity and structure. Still in slices, progressively, beside feature work, never one broad sweep. Fable plans; a model such as Opus 5.5 executes a slice from its brief. Planning, the division of work, the definition of work items and every roadmap change stay in the coordinator lane; a work lane executes and does not plan (D-WORKFLOW-189, 2026-10-23). The plan for the plan is `docs/reviews/plan-for-the-plan.md` (#346).

**Acceptance.** Every slice `docs/reviews/order.md` names has its audit folder under `docs/audits/` with the review depth its issue recorded, `tools/lint-audit-artifacts` PASS, and a punch-list issue whose items are resolved through Phase 7 or accepted by a register row; no release waits on the renovation: a finding that is a defect is a bug issue and holds or clears a release as every bug does (D-WORKFLOW-187, refining D-WORKFLOW-102). Acceptance: every slice the ordering analysis (#346) names has its audit folder under docs/audits/ with both council seats' packets, tools/lint-audit-artifacts PASS and a punch-list issue whose items are resolved through Phase 7 or accepted by a register row; a release waits only for the findings in the code it changes and for any known security, state-preservation or launch-path finding.

body:
The T7 audit of the generic packages the image builds (#654, area epic #848, renovation #339).
- **Scope:** 266 paths under `packages/`, 7,612 lines: 243 recipes and 23 data files.
- **Provenance:** 250 upstream-carried, 16 fork-own (13 added by the fork, 3 edited).
- **Read at:** `8ebaf8daad`; `reviewed-at` `4ea87f17dd`.
- **Depth:** Local (plan § 6c, D-WORKFLOW-184): no reviewer; Phase 4.5 in full.
- **What ran:** reads only. Nothing was built, run on a guest, or moved; no pin changed.
- **The incident:** the running log's § Incident records the one exception, an accidental run of `scripts/update_packages` in the lane's worktree. It was reverted before any commit.

**The currency table (`04` § Q4, also `q4-table.md` and `q4-pins.json`), 243 rows, each with a disposition naming its mover:**
- **223 follow the base merge:** LibreELEC master is ahead on 61 of them.
- **6 virtual and 1 inherited** also follow the base merge.
- **9 are current:** the project was read for each.
- **4 are the fork's to bump:** a Backlog issue each.

**15 findings in 15 items:** 0 critical, 0 high, 1 medium, 14 low.
- **Five `bug`s:**
  - #877 (PL-01, Medium): `libfmt`'s override had an empty `PKG_SHA256`. Filed by the coordinator and fixed in its packet `cf3a8d8e62`, which is ordered ahead of T5's branch.
  - #880 to #883 (PL-02 to PL-05, Low): dead primary URLs, all covered by ROCKNIX's mirror.
- **Four Backlog bumps** (PL-06 to PL-09): `brotli`, `ruby`, `glib-networking`, `webkitgtk`.
- **The #645 rows** (PL-10).
- **PL-11:** `btrfs-progs`, excluded on GENERIC_X64 by its `PKG_ARCH`; deferred to #879.
- **PL-12:** withdrawn.
- **PL-13 to PL-15:** three modernization rows.

**Folder:** [`docs/audits/2026_10_24-epic-m6-generic-packages-reached/`](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/feature/m6-generic-packages-reached-654/docs/audits/2026_10_24-epic-m6-generic-packages-reached). Punch list: [`05-punch-list.md`](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/feature/m6-generic-packages-reached-654/docs/audits/2026_10_24-epic-m6-generic-packages-reached/05-punch-list.md); analysis: [`04-analysis.md`](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/feature/m6-generic-packages-reached-654/docs/audits/2026_10_24-epic-m6-generic-packages-reached/04-analysis.md).

**Stage:** F done (`365172cef8`): S1 landed (`ce74769bab`, `49bddf9b3e`, `063f10154a`); every item is at a Phase 7 outcome; the full lint prints `PASS`.
